messages:
auditor_lina: Hey team — auditor request: need end-to-end evidence for an RBAC change affecting serviceAccount `inference-agent` on 2025-04-02. We need (1) PR/commit, (2) deploy timeline, (3) KMS Decrypts for alias rdw-inference-key around the deploy, and (4) any vuln/ops notes. Where should we source these?

anya_oncall: Hi @auditor_lina — PR is in repo, CI artifacts + CloudTrail + k8s audit will cover it. We can bundle.

jason_infra: PR link: github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4705, merge commit f4b2e11 (merged 2025-04-02T09:12:08Z). CircleCI job 9023 ran and executed `kubectl rollout restart deployment/inference` at 2025-04-02T09:12:34Z. CI artifact stored: s3://redwood-audit/ci-artifacts/2025/04/02/deploy-0901.json.

lee_sec: For KMS, query CloudTrail for eventName=Decrypt with requestParameters.keyId containing `rdw-inference-key` between 2025-04-02T09:05:00Z and 2025-04-02T09:20:00Z. Our encryptionContext includes `service_account:inference-agent`, which ties decrypts to the SA even if principal shows node role. Splunk sample: `index=cloudtrail eventName=Decrypt "rdw-inference-key" | table _time, userIdentity.principalId, requestParameters.encryptionContext`.

auditor_lina: Will you redact IPs/hostnames? Auditor needs ARNs/service_account names intact.

jason_infra: Redactions: node hostnames/IPs removed; we retain principal ARNs, encryptionContext, timestamps. Checksums included. Export path: s3://redwood-audit/evidence/1749202468-inference-agent-bundle.tar.gz.

anya_oncall: I'll run exporter: `redwood-audit export --from 2025-04-02T09:05:00Z --to 2025-04-02T09:20:00Z --keys rdw-inference-key --include-ci --include-cloudtrail --include-k8s --output s3://redwood-audit/evidence/1749202468-inference-agent-bundle.tar.gz`. It will add `timeline.csv` at 10s resolution and `mapping.txt` mapping artifacts to SOC2 CC6.1 / ISO A.9.

audit-bot: Evidence export started by anya_oncall. Job eexp-b12c.

lee_sec: Vulnerability note: INFSEC-1190 (linked in PR) — minor GRPC patch applied; triage note added and monitoring for 48h. I'll attach `INFSEC-1190-summary.txt`.

audit-bot: Evidence export complete: s3://redwood-audit/evidence/1749202468-inference-agent-bundle.tar.gz (sha256: 9f3c...).

auditor_lina: Received. I'll validate the bundle and open follow-ups if we need deeper raw CloudTrail. Thanks all :thumbsup:
